title: W15.1: author held-out discovery probe variants (independent of tuning)
description:
Author HELD-OUT probe variants for the W15 evaluation (eshyra-o9bd.19.15, design docs/audits/rules-awareness-transition/2026-07-30-integrated-transition-design.md sections 10-13).

WHAT: one new variant per probe class P1-P12 (design section 10; read each class's purpose, scenario shape and what it is designed to catch). Each variant is a DIFFERENT scenario of the same class: different records and situation, the same kind of rule-awareness demand. Not a paraphrase of the original fixture. Each is a DiagnosticFixture conforming exactly to packages/core/test/diagnostics/fixtureContract.ts (section 11 is the contract's rationale). Expectations (must-include targets, retained facts, typed relationships, routes, capability and state-effect expectations, explicit none values) are derived ONLY from the SRD source text and the committed pack records (packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1/records.json, record-relationships.json), with each expectation justified by the printed source in the fixture's evidence notes. Never derive an expectation from what the discovery pipeline produces.

INDEPENDENCE (the reason this child exists; it is an acceptance criterion): do NOT read packages/core/src/discovery/**, packages/core/test/discovery/**, or the existing probe fixtures under packages/core/test/diagnostics/probes/** (you may read their file names and the contract, nothing else). Do not run the discovery harness on your variants. A variant written after looking at pipeline behaviour is not held out.

WHERE: packages/core/test/diagnostics/held-out/ (one file per variant, plus an index), with a held-out manifest recording, for each variant, the authored-at commit (the HEAD you started from), the authored-at time, the author (Claude Sonnet 5.5 subagent), and the statement that it was not run against the pipeline. Add a lightweight test that validates every held-out fixture against the contract's shape and checks that every referenced record key exists in the pack. Nothing more: running the probes is eshyra-o9bd.19.15.2.

FREEZE RULE (record it in the manifest header): after .2's first run, a held-out fixture may not be edited. An edited fixture is relabelled consulted and excluded from held-out evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Twelve contract-valid variants, one per P1-P12 class, each a distinct scenario with source-justified expectations; the held-out manifest records authorship and that the variants were never run; the shape/key test passes; npm run verify:worktree passes; the independence rule was respected (state in the report what was read).
